visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair sits on a bed covered in a red and yellow checkered blanket with teddy bear patterns. She wears pink floral pajamas and looks focused while making a repetitive horizontal swiping motion with her right index finger in the air. The lighting is soft and warm from an indoor source. (2) The scene cuts to a bathroom where the woman is reflected in a mirror. She is brushing her teeth with her right hand while simultaneously performing the same rhythmic swiping gesture with her left index finger. Various toiletries and a water bottle are visible on the sink counter. (3) The woman stands at an outdoor bus stop wearing a grey blazer over her pajamas and carrying a beige tote bag. She continues the swiping motion with her right hand while looking towards the road. The background shows bus stop signage and moving traffic in daylight. (4) The woman is at a reception counter or service desk indoors, facing a male staff member in a black apron. She maintains the finger-swiping gesture directed towards the counter while the staff member looks at her. (5) The woman stands in front of closed elevator doors in a hallway. She continues the swiping motion as she waits. (6) She walks through a doorway into an office space, still swiping her finger mid-air. (7) Inside a bright office with multiple desks, she walks past a colleague while continuously swiping her finger. (8) The woman sits at an office desk with a computer monitor and a colorful mechanical keyboard. She swipes her finger over a yellow mousepad before grasping a white computer mouse. (9) A screen recording shows a computer desktop with a mountain landscape. A mouse cursor moves rapidly across the screen in a zigzag pattern before clicking to open a browser window featuring a cute cartoon animal background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous montage to show a woman obsessively practicing a finger-swiping motion in every possible daily scenario—from bed to the bus stop—ultimately revealing the payoff: her ability to find and move a computer mouse cursor with extreme speed and precision. It satirizes the habit of over-practicing mundane digital skills.
